'''Tsukubusuma Shrine''' (都久夫須麻神社, ''Tsukubusuma Jinja'') is a [[Shinto]] shrine on {{ill|Chikubu Island|en|Chikubu Island|qid=Q2975401|lt=Chikubu Island}} in {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|en|Shiga Prefecture|qid=Q131358|lt=Shiga Prefecture}}, Japan. Its {{nihongo|main hall|本殿|honden}} is a {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|qid=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure of Japan}}. The shrine's main festival is held annually on June 15. It is also called '''Chikubushima Shrine''' (竹生島神社, ''Chikubushima Jinja'').
